name: Diagnostic accuracy studies (QUADAS-2 structure)
about: Key provides the assessment structure: four bias domains and three applicability domains with their ratings. The questions are in the official tool: open it beside Key, answer there, and record each domain's rating and its basis here. Bristol now lists QUADAS-3 as the successor; build its structure with New tool if you use it.
licence: QUADAS-2 is published by the University of Bristol; no licence for the tool is stated (site: "Copyright © 2026 University of Bristol. All rights reserved."; checked 2026-11-27 at https://www.bristol.ac.uk/population-health-sciences/projects/quadas/history/quadas-2/, which also says QUADAS-2 is superseded by QUADAS-3). Treated as restricted: Key ships none of its text.

overall.note: Key's default suggestion is the least favourable bias domain (applicability not counted).
